Browser-QA-only file navigation, interaction, screenshot, and result policy are outside lifecycle responsibility.
Lifecycle cleanup and downstream failure remain independently reported.
Browser-QA completed, passed, and warning classification are outside lifecycle responsibility.
Owned-resource reconciliation remains required before a lower-tier fallback.
An identified external runtime owner is protected and receives responsibility.
Preserve retains lifecycle handoff, later owner, and safe later Stop without Browser QA.
Identity mismatch remains an unresolved result with no speculative termination.
Identity-bound validation-to-termination mechanics belong to the accepted private Windows runtime seam.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. After an ordinary app edit and HEAD change, this command waits for exit normally; every process and all work it started have finished, with no descendant or resource left to manage. Return only the lifecycle decision JSON; do not inspect the OS or invoke lifecycle execution.
evals.expected_output: The synchronous command is excluded without creating lifecycle facts or actions.
expectations: Reports that the request is not applicable.
Reports no lifecycle fact bundle and no lifecycle actions.

evals.prompt: Explicitly invoke the lifecycle candidate. On Windows a short CLI exits 0 after spawning a persistent child. A verified official launcher contract gives this run a fresh binding covering that child, a bounded test/readiness check, and an identity-bound Stop in the same tool's finally. The host call returns only after cleanup, so it has no return-live capability. The requested route is temporary Stop; downstream returns HTTP 202 and one probe fails. Return only lifecycle decision JSON, planning Stop even if downstream fails. Do not execute anything.
evals.expected_output: Select the official current-run owner and same-tool Stop without return-live evidence; keep HTTP/probe results separate from OS exit.
expectations: Selects the official current-run owner rather than excluding the CLI or assuming helper root ownership.
Schedules identity-bound Stop in the same tool's finally without requiring host return-live; never infers OS exit from HTTP 202 or one failed probe.

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。Windows 上首次啟動的新測試服務走同 tool 暫時 Stop；既有工具／框架契約提供涵蓋該服務的 scoped owner、隔離 stdio、bounded test/readiness、當次 fresh binding 與同 tool identity-bound Stop cleanup。host tool 可在 cleanup 後才返回，尚無此新服務的歷史 host return-live probe。只回傳 lifecycle decision JSON，不執行命令。
evals.expected_output: 直接選 managed tier；同 tool Stop 不以缺少歷史 host return-live 阻止新服務，當次 binding 與 cleanup 仍須新鮮。
expectations: 採涵蓋 bounded test、ownership 與同 tool Stop 的框架契約，不要求 host return-live 測試。
本次資源仍取得 fresh binding、readiness 與 Stop。

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。Windows 特殊短命 CLI 留 child 的同一官方 launcher/tool／mode／route 已由 caller 驗證能在 child 存活時返回；官方介面可提供涵蓋 child 的當次 fresh binding、bounded readiness、later owner 與安全 Stop。此後只有普通 app code edit 與 HEAD 變更，執行方式、相關環境及 owner contract 均未變。本次要求 Preserve；只規劃取得當次 fresh binding、readiness 與 Stop evidence 的 lifecycle decision JSON，不執行命令。
evals.expected_output: 沿用 route return-live capability，不因普通 app edit／HEAD 重測；本次 resource facts 重新取得。
expectations: 沿用同路由已驗證 capability。
規劃每次新的 owner binding、readiness 與 safe later Stop。

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。Windows 短命 CLI 留 child 的同一官方 launcher/tool route 已驗證在 child 存活時 host 返回，官方契約涵蓋 child ownership、later owner 與 safe Stop。上次 app 的 workload-specific readiness 失敗，但 owner 已核對該次 binding 並成功 Stop，沒有未清理資源；host/tool/mode/環境及 owner contract 均未變。現在規劃下一次 Preserve，需重新取得當次 binding 與 readiness；只回傳 lifecycle decision JSON，不執行命令。
evals.expected_output: 上次 readiness 只影響當次 resource；沿用已驗證 host-return route，不要求新 return-live probe，為新資源規劃 fresh facts。
expectations: 保留同 route 的 host-return capability，app readiness 失敗不使它失效。
上次 binding 已 Stop；下一次 Preserve 規劃新 binding、readiness 與 later Stop。

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。Windows 特殊短命 CLI 留 child 的 Preserve route 契約未涵蓋 host/tool 在 child 活著時返回，且無該 route 的實測證據；診斷 fixture 有合法 owner、Stop 與中斷後仍會自行結束的獨立 bounded lifetime，並可核對 tool result、process identity 與最後的 OS exit。正式 workload 另有可涵蓋 child 的 current-run owner、later owner 和 safe Stop 契約。只規劃安全診斷，不啟動正式服務，不使用 shell timeout，也不改成 Stop；回傳既有欄位的 lifecycle decision JSON。
evals.expected_output: 先規劃 bounded targeted 診斷，未知不直接形成永遠 block 的循環，也不冒充正式 Preserve 已驗證。
expectations: 診斷的 fixture 有合法 owner、Stop、獨立 bounded lifetime 與 exit 核對。
正式 Preserve 前仍需 host return-live evidence。

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。特殊短命 CLI 的舊 host/tool route 曾經通過 return-live 測試；現在改用不同工具與 argument mode。新工具已有適用的新 managed lifecycle contract，明確涵蓋背景返回、持續存活 child 的當次 ownership、bounded readiness 與 identity-bound Stop，並可取得 fresh binding；新 route 尚無歷史實測。沒有未清理的舊資源。只回傳 lifecycle decision JSON，不執行命令。
evals.expected_output: 舊 route 證據不套用新工具；新 route 的完整契約足夠直接選 managed tier，不要求 empirical return-live probe。
expectations: 依新 route 的背景返回、ownership 與 Stop 契約直接選 tier。
仍規劃本次 fresh binding 和 readiness。

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。特殊短命 CLI 的原 host/tool return-live route 已驗證，但本次換了 execution tool 和 argument mode；新 route 的正式 Preserve 契約已有可涵蓋 child 的 current-run owner、later owner 與 safe Stop，只有 host return-live 未知，且沒有新資源啟動。診斷 fixture 另有合法 owner、Stop 與中斷後獨立 bounded lifetime。只規劃新 route 的 targeted return-live 診斷，回傳既有欄位的 lifecycle decision JSON，不執行命令。
evals.expected_output: 不沿用舊 route 能力；只有 return-live 待證，先規劃 bounded targeted 診斷，未宣稱新的 binding 已建立。
expectations: 不以舊工具的 capability 證明新工具。
已有正式 owner/Stop 契約且 fixture 自有合法 owner/Stop，僅對未知 return-live 規劃 bounded 診斷。

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。特殊短命 CLI 的新 Preserve route 已用合法 owner、Stop 與獨立 bounded lifetime 的 fixture 證明 host 在 child 活著時返回，且已核對 fixture OS exit；但正式 workload 沒有涵蓋 child 的 owner binding、later owner 或可執行 Stop 契約。目前沒有正式 resource 啟動。只回傳 lifecycle decision JSON；不因診斷成功就啟動正式服務。
evals.expected_output: fixture 只證明 return-live，不能授權正式 ownership 或 Stop；取得適用正式契約前 pre-launch block/handoff。
expectations: 明確指出缺正式 child ownership、later owner 與 Stop authority。
不把成功 probe 當成正式 tier launch 授權。

evals.prompt: 明確呼叫 agent-process-lifecycle candidate。特殊短命 CLI 的 Preserve route 先前可在 child 活著時返回，但最近同一 host/tool route 發生 timeout，原因未知，可能是 host 等 child exit；前次 binding 的 cleanup 仍未確認。一般 framework 契約存在但不涵蓋該失敗 route。只回傳 lifecycle decision JSON，先處理既有 binding 的 reconciliation，並將可能受影響的 host return-live capability 列為待查；不啟動新資源。
evals.expected_output: 未知原因 timeout 使可能受影響的 host-return capability 待查，而非所有 route capability 全面失效；先保留 unresolved resource evidence 再做 targeted 驗證。
expectations: 查明 timeout 原因前只暫停可能受影響的 host-return 能力，不泛化失效。
前次 binding 未清理時先 reconciliation，不靜默重啟或改 Stop。

evals.prompt: Explicitly invoke the lifecycle candidate. A Windows short CLI exits 0 leaving a live child; a fresh owner binding and later Stop method are known. This exact host/tool route was already observed waiting until child exit, and no new targeted verification has overturned that failure; the only new timestamp is shell-end. The requested disposition is Preserve. Return only lifecycle decision JSON before production launch; do not switch to Stop or treat a general managed contract as proof for this failed route.
evals.expected_output: Blocks the known-failed Preserve route before launch without silently turning it into Stop.
expectations: Rejects shell-end as host completion and a general contract as a substitute for targeted evidence.
Returns a pre-launch block and identifies missing return-live capability.

evals.prompt: Explicitly invoke the lifecycle candidate. A Windows CLI exits before its child becomes ready. No managed or official launcher owner binds the child; the Windows self-managed helper observes the CLI root before readiness and cannot be assumed to adopt an exited launcher's child. Return only lifecycle decision JSON before launch.
evals.expected_output: Blocks before launching a child it cannot safely own; no PID or port adoption.
expectations: Rejects a root-only helper as a descendant owner.
Does not make a speculative termination claim.

evals.prompt: Explicitly invoke the lifecycle candidate. A Windows temporary Stop route had a verified current-run descendant binding; the host interrupted the tool before its finally could be confirmed. A test fixture has an independent bounded lifetime, but there is no evidence yet of child OS exit. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; no guessed PID/name/port kill and no completed Stop claim.
evals.expected_output: Reconciles as unresolved pending owner-backed evidence; independent fixture deadline is not a production Stop guarantee.
expectations: Does not assume interrupted finally executed.
Keeps lifecycle unresolved and retains ownership evidence.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. A local watcher still needs a lifecycle decision, but its owner contract changed after the previous decision. Return only lifecycle decision JSON showing event-driven invalidation and the repeated reasoning-only entry check. Do not inspect the OS or execute lifecycle work.
evals.expected_output: The stale facts are invalidated before the next lifecycle decision and no stale ownership is reused.
expectations: Invalidates the prior fact bundle because owner data changed.
Repeats the reasoning-only entry check before the next decision.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. A Windows framework provides the first viable managed lifecycle contract and a fresh opaque current-run binding for a local worker. Return only lifecycle decision JSON. Do not inspect the OS, reconstruct a PID tree, or invoke a lifecycle shell command.
evals.expected_output: Selects the verified managed owner through its opaque binding and leaves execution to that owner contract.
expectations: Selects the managed tier without a PID tree.
Reports the opaque current-run binding and managed minimum outcomes.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. On Windows, managed lifecycle is not viable, but a verified external launcher is the first viable execution tier. Its documented lifecycle interface provides a fresh current-run binding and valid Stop disposition for this Agent-caused local worker. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; do not execute a command or select the self-managed helper.
evals.expected_output: Selects the verified external launcher as the first viable current-run execution tier before self-managed fallback.
expectations: Distinguishes a current-run external launcher from an external-owner handoff.
Reports the launcher binding and seven classified outcomes.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. A local service has an identified external runtime owner with a documented lifecycle interface, but it was not started by this run. Return only lifecycle decision JSON and hand responsibility to that owner. Do not claim current-run cleanup or invoke lifecycle execution.
evals.expected_output: Protects the external runtime owner and returns a responsibility-oriented handoff.
expectations: Does not claim the service as current-run ownership.
Returns a handoff with lifecycle and downstream results separated.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. On Windows, an Agent-caused local worker needs to outlive the tool call, but no managed, external, or self-managed tier has both a verifiable owner and a Stop or Preserve disposition. Return only lifecycle decision JSON. Block before launch and do not execute lifecycle work.
evals.expected_output: Blocks the unsafe launch and returns the missing safety evidence and responsible next owner.
expectations: Blocks before launch when no execution tier is viable.
Returns a machine-readable unresolved responsibility payload.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. On Windows, an Agent-caused temporary listener needs a self-managed lifecycle because no higher tier is viable. Foreground execution and a tool timeout are offered as shortcuts. A valid Stop disposition is available. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; do not actually execute a command.
evals.expected_output: Rejects foreground and timeout shortcuts, then plans the two-action Windows self-managed Stop lifecycle.
expectations: Rejects foreground execution and timeout as detachment evidence.
Uses only Launch and Finalize with Stop.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. On Windows, an Agent-caused GUI application must remain available after the initiating tool call. No higher lifecycle tier is viable, a bounded readiness signal and a valid Stop disposition are supplied, and no Browser QA is requested. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; do not execute a command.
evals.expected_output: Uses the same two-action self-managed lifecycle contract for a GUI without taking Browser QA responsibility.
expectations: Treats the GUI as a lifecycle resource rather than Browser QA.
Uses Launch and Finalize with Stop.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. On Windows, an Agent-caused watcher requires self-managed lifecycle and must remain running for a named later owner. This exact route's host tool has been observed by the caller to return while the watcher remains alive. A bounded readiness signal, fresh binding, record, stdio, and safe later Stop handoff are available. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; do not execute a command.
evals.expected_output: Plans Launch then Finalize with Preserve and reports the later ownership handoff.
expectations: Treats Preserve as a Finalize disposition, not a third action.
Returns the later owner and safe Stop handoff.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. The caller already verified this exact Windows route's host tool returns with the watcher alive. A self-managed Preserve handoff atomically published its fresh binding, record, isolated stdio, bounded readiness, named later owner, and safe later Stop method. Exact temporary-artifact cleanup is unresolved after that publication. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; do not revoke the published handoff or execute a command.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the published handoff while reporting temporary-artifact cleanup as unresolved.
expectations: Keeps Preserve publication distinct from temporary-artifact cleanup.
Delivers handoff facts while lifecycle cleanup is unresolved.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. A Windows Agent-caused detached finite job exits naturally after returning its result and has no residue. It was not cancelled, timed out, or lost. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; do not terminate anything.
evals.expected_output: Reports natural exit, result, and no residue without termination.
expectations: Distinguishes natural completion from forced finalization.
Does not terminate the naturally exited job.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. A Windows Agent-caused detached finite job exceeded its deadline before reporting a result. Current live ownership proof is available and the timeout has triggered a Stop disposition. Return only lifecycle decision JSON; do not execute a command.
evals.expected_output: Allows identity-bound finalization only because timeout and live ownership proof are present.
expectations: Allows termination only after the timeout trigger and live ownership proof.
Reports Stop through Finalize rather than a third action.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. On Windows, the first selected managed tier has a readiness failure after starting an owned resource. Its selected owner has completed reconciliation with terminal disposition stopped, so a Windows self-managed fallback is now eligible. Return only lifecycle decision JSON with failed_tier managed-lifecycle, failure_kind readiness-failure, reconciliation.required true, reconciliation.final_disposition stopped, fallback_tier windows-self-managed, evidence_paths, and a lifecycle_result object. Do not execute commands.
evals.expected_output: Requires reconciliation before fallback, then records the eligible self-managed tier.
expectations: Does not race or fall through before reconciliation.
Records a terminal disposition before selecting the lower tier.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. On Windows, a self-managed Finalize Stop finds that its live identity evidence no longer matches the recorded binding. Return only lifecycle decision JSON. Do not terminate the uncertain resource or invent a fallback target.
evals.expected_output: Reports identity mismatch as unresolved and preserves targeted evidence without termination.
expectations: Refuses speculative termination when identity evidence differs.
Leaves unresolved responsibility visible to the next owner.

evals.prompt: Explicitly manually invoke the agent-process-lifecycle candidate. A Windows owned worker has a valid Stop disposition. Its downstream task result is exactly {"status":"failed","reason":"workload assertion failed"}, but lifecycle cleanup succeeds. Return only lifecycle decision JSON and preserve the downstream result unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Reports lifecycle cleanup separately and preserves the caller-owned downstream failure unchanged.
expectations: Does not let downstream failure suppress lifecycle cleanup.
Keeps lifecycle and downstream results separate.

Return only lifecycle decision JSON. Do not inspect the OS, launch, terminate, call a lifecycle shell, or invent Linux or macOS mechanics.
